# Awaited OAuth lookup assertions still need expected-result messages

All 15 directly converted getRefreshToken equality assertions await the new Promise but have no message argument. The CalDAV and CardDAV shared all-login helpers likewise compare count and four credential fields without messages. Async ordering does not supply failure diagnostics. The comments identify cases and the helpers clear storage, but neither is an assertion message. This is a scoped diagnostic finding, with no test execution or broader rewrite request.

Scope: Authentication test diagnostics.
